title: How Viewer Tuning, Presence, and Attention Respond to Ad Content and Predict Brand Search Lift
authors: Matthew McGranaghan; Jūra Liaukonytė; Kenneth C. Wilbur
eligible_reason: TV viewer tuning, presence and attention during ads: ad-viewer-level outcomes regressed on ad characteristics with ad-title, viewer and pod FE; Google Trends search lift around ad airings regressed on viewer response. No staggered binary treatment or DiD.
design_notes: TVision/Code/wpwtv_analysis_accepted.R: feols(dv ~ factor(ad_len) + time_elapsed + factor(pod_position) | ad_title + viewer_id + unique_pod); Google Trends script: lm(post_min_pre ~ first + x).
data_files_note: README: TVision data simulated from uniform distributions; ad timing randomized; only Google Trends files are real.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); screened from README, regression inventory, main-results code and OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
